DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。窓口でどのようなお手伝いをご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What help would you like at the counter?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 来週の生活相談を予約しています。同僚にも説明を一緒に聞いてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予約済みの生活相談に同僚も同席して説明を聞けるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have a life-advice appointment next week. May a colleague sit in and hear the explanation with me?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether a colleague may attend your booked life-advice consultation to hear the explanation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約内容を確認します。同僚の方が、ご本人に代わって手続きするご予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check your booking. Will the colleague handle the procedures on your behalf?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: いいえ、私も行きます。同僚には、わからない言葉を説明してもらいたいだけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分も出席し、同僚は代理手続きではなく言葉の補助だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: No, I will attend too. I only want my colleague to explain words I do not understand.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you will attend yourself and your colleague is helping with language, not acting on your behalf. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 同席希望として担当へ伝えられます。予約者名と日時をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I can pass on your request for accompaniment. Please give the booking name, date and time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: グエンで、来週火曜の午前十時です。同行者は一人です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 予約者名、来週火曜十時、同行者一人を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Nguyen, next Tuesday at ten in the morning. One person will accompany me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give your booking name, next Tuesday at ten, and one accompanying person. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 同席について担当に確認しました。その相談では一人の同席ができます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I checked with the person in charge. One accompanying person is allowed for that consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。質問や回答は私自身が行い、必要な時だけ助けてもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分が質問や回答を行い、必要な時だけ同僚の補助を受けると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I will ask and answer questions myself and get help only when needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will ask and answer questions yourself, with your colleague helping only as needed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その形で結構です。予約人数の欄に同行者一人を記録しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: That is fine. I recorded one accompanying person in the booking's attendee field.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 日時は火曜十時のままですね。本人の私と同僚の二人で行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 予約日時が変わらず、本人と同僚の二人で来ると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: The appointment remains Tuesday at ten, correct? I will come myself with my colleague, two of us.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm that the booking time is unchanged and you and your colleague will come together. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、日時は変わりません。当日お待ちしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, the time is unchanged. We look forward to seeing you then.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。会計で確認したいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Is there anything you want to check about your bill?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 渡された明細の名前が私の名前ではありません。内容を読む前に返して確認してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 明細の名前が別人なので、内容を読む前に返して確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: The name on the statement I was given is not mine. Can I return it and have you check before I read the contents?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Return the statement before reading it because the name belongs to someone else, and ask staff to check. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 失礼しました。診察券をお願いします。お名前も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I am sorry. May I have your patient card? I will confirm your name too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: グエンです。この診察券の番号でお願いします。違う方の明細は写真に撮っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 自分の名前と診察券番号を示し、別人の明細は撮影していないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Nguyen. Please use the number on this patient card. I have not photographed the other person's statement.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show your name and patient-card number and say you have not photographed the other person's statement. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受渡しを確認します。お支払いはもうお済みですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check the handover. Have you paid already?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだです。名前の違いに気づいたので、支払う前にこちらへ来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未払いで、名前の相違に気づき支払い前に来たと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Not yet. I noticed the name was different and came here before paying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not paid and came before payment after noticing the different name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご本人の明細をご用意しました。お名前と診察券番号が一致するかご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I have prepared your own statement. Please check whether your name and patient-card number match.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今度は両方一致しています。ただ、金額も改めてこちらの明細で確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 新しい明細の名前と番号は一致すると確認し、金額も改めて確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Both match this time. But I would also like to check the amount again using this statement.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that the new statement's name and number match and say you want to recheck the amount too. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、今回のお会計はこの金額です。先ほどの別の明細の金額ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, this is the amount for your bill. It is not the amount on the other statement from earlier.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 自分の名前と番号、この金額を確認できました。こちらのお会計を支払います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分の明細の名前、番号、金額を確認して支払うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have confirmed my name, number and this amount. I will pay this bill.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you have checked your statement's name, number and amount and will pay. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お待たせしました。お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Thank you for waiting. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのようなご用件でしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 鍵について連絡をいただきました。自分のものか特徴を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 鍵の発見連絡を受け、自分の品か特徴を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: You contacted me about keys. I want to check their features to see whether they are mine.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you were contacted about found keys and want to compare features to see if they are yours. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 届出の控えをお持ちですか。鍵は何本の組でしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have the report receipt? How many keys were in the set?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この控えです。鍵は二本で、丸い緑のキーホルダーが付いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 届出控えを示し、鍵二本と丸い緑のキーホルダーを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here is the receipt. Two keys with a round green key ring.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the report receipt and describe two keys and a round green key ring. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 連絡した品も二本の組です。キーホルダー以外に特徴はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: The item we contacted you about is also a set of two. Are there features other than the key ring?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 大きい鍵の持ち手に白い傷があります。鍵の形だけでは自分のものと判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 大きい鍵の持ち手の白い傷を伝え、形だけでは断定できないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: There is a white scratch on the larger key's handle. I cannot identify them as mine from the key shape alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Mention the white scratch on the larger key's handle and explain that shape alone does not confirm ownership. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの品にはその傷がありません。緑のキーホルダーの文字も確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: This item does not have that scratch. Let us also check the lettering on the green key ring.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私の物は文字がありません。こちらには文字があるので、別の方の鍵だと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分のキーホルダーは文字なしで、提示品は文字があるため別人のものだと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Mine has no lettering. This one does, so I think these are someone else's keys.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that your key ring has no letters but this one does, so it belongs to someone else. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 一致しないので、この品はお渡ししません。あなたの届出は引き続き照会できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: They do not match, so we will not hand this item over. We can continue inquiries under your report.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今回は受け取りません。届出を残し、特徴が合う物の連絡を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 今回の品は受け取らず、届出を残して特徴の合う品の連絡を待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not collect these. Please keep my report, and I will wait for contact about an item with matching features.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will not collect this item, will keep the report open and wait for an item with matching features. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。照合にご協力ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Thank you for helping with the comparison.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。郵便のことで何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you with your mail?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私だけ引っ越します。家族は今の家に残るので、転居届の対象を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本人だけ引越し家族は残るため、郵便転居届の対象を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Only I am moving. My family will stay in our current home, so I want to check whom the postal change-of-address notice covers.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that only you are moving while your family stays, so you want to check the people covered by the postal change-of-address notice. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 引越すのは一人ですね。届出の氏名欄はどのように記入しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: One person is moving, then. How did you fill out the names on the notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 自分と妻の名前を書いてしまいました。でも、妻は引っ越しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 妻の名前も書いたが妻は引越さないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I mistakenly wrote my name and my wife's. But my wife is not moving.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you also wrote your wife's name but she is not moving. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この届出はまだ提出していませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Have you not submitted this notice yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだです。提出前に気づいたので、私だけに直す方法を聞きに来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: まだ未提出で、提出前に本人のみへ直す方法を聞きに来たと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Not yet. I noticed before submitting and came to ask how to correct it to cover only me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that it is unsubmitted and you came to ask how to correct it to only yourself before submission. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 新しい用紙で、ご本人だけの転居として書き直せます。旧住所と新住所も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can rewrite a new form for your own move only. Please check the old and new addresses too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私の名前だけを書きます。妻の名前は新しい用紙に書かず、妻の郵便は元の住所で受け取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 新用紙は自分だけ記入し、妻の郵便は元の住所で受け取ると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will write only my name. I will not write my wife's on the new form, and her mail will be received at the original address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that you will put only yourself on the new form and your wife's mail will be received at the original address. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 書き直した内容を確認してから、提出の手順をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: After checking the rewritten information, we will guide you through submission.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 対象は私一人です。二つの住所と名前を見直してから、届出を提出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 対象は本人一人で、旧新住所と名前を見直してから提出すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: It covers only me. I will review both addresses and my name before submitting it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that it covers you alone and you will review the old and new addresses and name before submission. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。ご本人だけの転居として用紙をご確認ください。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please check the form as a move for you alone. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。お取引について何を確認したいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to check about your transaction?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 振込予約の画面が止まり、もう一度操作しました。二件受け付けられていないか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 画面停止後に再操作し、振込予約が二件になっていないか確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: The scheduled-transfer screen froze and I operated it again. I want to check whether two requests were accepted.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to check for duplicate scheduled transfers after operating again when the screen froze. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 確認には受付番号などが必要です。完了画面や履歴は見られますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We need reference numbers or similar details. Can you view the completion screen or history?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 履歴には同じ相手と金額が二行あります。番号は違いますが、まだ実行されたかはわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 履歴に同じ相手と金額が二行で番号は異なるが、実行状態は不明だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: The history has two lines with the same recipient and amount. Their numbers differ, but I do not know whether they have been executed yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the history has two lines with the same recipient and amount but different numbers, with execution status unknown. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当がそれぞれの状態を調べます。もう一度振込操作をするのはお控えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person in charge will check each status. Please refrain from another transfer operation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 三度目の操作はしません。一件だけ送る予定なので、余分な予約があれば取り消せるか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 追加操作をせず、一件だけ送る予定なので余分な予約の取消しを相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not try a third time. I only intended one transfer, so I want to ask whether an extra reservation can be canceled.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will make no additional operation and want to discuss canceling any extra reservation because you intend only one transfer. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認したところ、二件とも予約として受け付けられています。取消し可能な一件を担当と選んで手続きできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We checked and both were accepted as scheduled transfers. You can select one eligible for cancellation with the person in charge and process it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: どちらかを自分で決めず、受付番号を照合して一件だけ残したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 受付番号を担当と照合し、勝手に選ばず一件だけ残したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Rather than choose one myself, I want to compare reference numbers with staff and keep only one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you want to compare reference numbers with staff and leave only one without choosing on your own. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 二つの番号を担当へ引き継ぎます。取消し結果も画面で確認していただきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will pass both numbers to the person in charge. You will also check the cancellation result on screen.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 取消しが完了したかと、残った一件の予定を確認します。確認前に別の送金はしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 取消し結果と残る一件の予定を確認し、確認前に別送金しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will confirm whether cancellation is complete and the schedule of the remaining transfer. I will not make another transfer before checking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the cancellation result and remaining transfer schedule without sending other money beforehand. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当へご案内します。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I will direct you to the person in charge. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: いらっしゃいませ。売場で何かご不明な点はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Welcome. Is anything unclear in the sales area?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 棚では安い値段だったのに、この商品の表示価格が違います。値札を一緒に見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 棚と商品の価格表示が違うため、値札を一緒に確認してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: The shelf showed a cheaper price, but this product's displayed price differs. Could you look at the price label with me?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask staff to check the price label together because the shelf and product prices differ. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの小さい表示に、会員価格とあります。会員カードはお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: This small label says member price. Do you have a membership card?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 持っていません。大きい数字だけを見て、誰でもその値段だと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 会員カードはなく、大きな数字を全員の価格だと思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. I only looked at the large number and thought it was the price for everyone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have no membership card and thought the large number was everyone's price. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 会員でない場合は、こちらの通常価格です。今日は会員登録もご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: For nonmembers, this is the regular price. We can also explain registration today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日は登録しません。他の人のカードを借りず、通常価格でいくつ買うか決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今日は登録せず、他人のカードも借りず通常価格で購入数を決めると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will not register today. I will not borrow someone else's card; I will decide how many to buy at the regular price.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will not register today or borrow another person's card, and will choose the quantity at the regular price. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 一つずつ購入できます。今はかごに三つ入っていますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can buy them individually. There are three in your basket now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 通常価格なら二つにします。余分な一つを売場に戻してもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 三つから二つに減らし、一つを売場へ戻してよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: At the regular price, I will take two. May I put the extra one back in the sales area?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Reduce three to two and ask whether you may return one to the sales area. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、こちらの棚の商品なので元の場所へ戻せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, this product belongs on this shelf, so you can return it to its original place.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一つ戻して二つ買います。会計でも通常価格になっているか確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一つ戻して二つ購入し、会計の通常価格も確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will put one back and buy two. I will also check that checkout uses the regular price.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will return one and buy two, and check the regular price at checkout too. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お買上げありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Thank you for your purchase.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。公園で何をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What are you looking for in the park?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 中央広場で待ち合わせですが、ここには誰もいません。別の場所も同じ名前ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 中央広場で待合せだが誰もおらず、同名の別の場所があるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: We are meeting at Central Square, but nobody is here. Is there another place with the same name?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that nobody is at your Central Square meeting point and ask whether another place has the same name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 案内によって呼び方が違うことがあります。待合せの地図や写真はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Names can differ between guides. Do you have a meeting map or photo?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 主催者が送った地図です。滑り台の横に集合印があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 主催者の地図を示し、滑り台横に集合印があると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here is the map the organizer sent. The meeting mark is beside the slide.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the organizer's map and say the meeting mark is beside the slide. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その印は、この先の子ども広場です。今いる噴水の広場とは違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: That mark is the children's square ahead. It is different from the fountain square where you are now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 噴水ではなく滑り台の横ですね。地図の矢印通りに池の方へ進めば着きますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 噴水ではなく滑り台横と確認し、池方向の経路でよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Beside the slide, not the fountain, then. Will I get there by heading toward the pond as the map's arrow shows?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm beside the slide rather than the fountain and ask whether the route toward the pond is correct. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 池への近道は今日は閉鎖中です。舗装された道を回れば行けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: The shortcut to the pond is closed today. You can go around on the paved path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 閉鎖中の近道には入らず、舗装の道で回ります。主催者には移動中だと連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 閉鎖中の近道は避け舗装道を回り、主催者に移動中と連絡すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will avoid the closed shortcut and go around on the paved path. I will tell the organizer I am on my way.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will avoid the closed shortcut, take the paved path around, and tell the organizer you are moving there. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、道の分岐で子ども広場の表示をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, look for the children's square sign at the fork.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 滑り台のある広場を目指します。着いたら地図の集合印と照合して主催者に知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 滑り台の広場で集合印を照合し、到着を主催者に知らせると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will head for the square with the slide. When I arrive, I will compare it with the meeting mark and let the organizer know.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will match the meeting mark at the square with the slide and tell the organizer you have arrived. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その道でお進みください。待合せがうまくいきますように。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02204-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please follow that path. I hope your meeting goes well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何をお手伝いできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. How can I help you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 券売機で切符だけ取ってしまいました。釣銭を取り忘れたかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 券売機で切符だけ取り、釣銭を忘れた可能性を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I took only my ticket from the machine. I may have forgotten the change.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you took only the ticket from the machine and may have left your change. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの券売機を、何時ごろ使いましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which ticket machine did you use, and around what time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 右端の機械を二分ほど前に使いました。千円札で四百円の切符を買いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 右端の機械を二分前に使い、千円で四百円の切符を買ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: The one on the far right, about two minutes ago. I bought a 400-yen ticket with a 1,000-yen note.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you used the far-right machine two minutes ago and bought a 400-yen ticket with 1,000 yen. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 釣銭口やお手元を、もう確認されましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Have you checked the change tray and your belongings yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 釣銭口は空で、財布にもありません。六百円のはずですが、誰かが取ったとは断定できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 釣銭口と財布に六百円が見当たらないが、他人が取ったとは断定しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: The tray is empty and it is not in my wallet. It should be 600 yen, but I cannot conclude someone took it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you cannot find the 600 yen in the change tray or wallet, but will not conclude someone else took it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 機械と周辺の確認を担当に依頼します。購入した切符はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will ask the person in charge to check the machine and surroundings. Do you have the ticket you bought?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この切符です。券面の時刻も確認してください。機械を勝手に開けようとはしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 切符を示し、券面時刻の確認を依頼し、機械を開けようとしていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Here is the ticket. Please check the time printed on it too. I have not tried to open the machine myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show the ticket, ask staff to check its printed time, and explain you have not tried to open the machine. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 釣銭の扱いを確認中です。この場で必ず戻るとはまだお伝えできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: We are checking how the change was handled. We cannot yet say it will definitely be returned here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 確認の結果を待ちます。列車の時刻が近いので、出発までに返事がなければ連絡方法を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 結果を待ち、出発までに返事がなければ連絡方法を相談すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will wait for the result. My train leaves soon, so if there is no answer before departure, I will ask how we can stay in contact.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will wait for the result and discuss contact methods if no answer comes before departure. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 切符を手元にお持ちください。確認の結果が出たらお知らせします。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please keep the ticket with you. We will let you know when we have the result. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。どのようなご相談でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. What would you like to discuss?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家に届いた市役所の封筒ですが、私ではない名前です。開けずに持ってきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 別人宛ての市役所の封筒が届き、未開封で持参したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: This city-office envelope arrived at my home, but it is addressed to someone else. I brought it unopened.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that a city-office envelope for someone else arrived and you brought it unopened. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 封筒の住所は、今のお住まいと一致していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Does the address on the envelope match where you live now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 住所と部屋番号は合っています。宛名の方は知りませんが、前の住人かもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 住所と部屋番号は合っているが宛名の人を知らず、前住人かもしれないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: The address and room number are correct. I do not know the addressee, but it may be a previous resident.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the address and room number match, but you do not know the addressee and they may be a previous resident. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 宛名から担当を確認します。ご本人の通知だと考えて、何か手続きをしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will identify the responsible section from the addressee. Have you done any procedure thinking it was your notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: していません。中身を読んで自分の手続きを決めることもしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分の通知と考えて手続きせず、中身も読んでいないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: No. I have not read the contents or used them to decide my own procedures either.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you did not treat it as your own notice, do any procedure, or read the contents. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この封筒は担当で確認のためお預かりできます。ご自身が待っている通知もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: The responsible section can take this envelope for checking. Are you waiting for any notice of your own?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 別に相談の予約案内を待っています。この封筒とは別なので、その案内が届いたとは思っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分の予約案内も待っているが、この別人の封筒とは別だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Separately, I am waiting for consultation appointment instructions. That is different from this envelope, so I do not think my instructions have arrived.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you are also waiting for your own appointment instructions, which are separate from this other person's envelope. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 予約案内の確認は別の担当です。必要なら予約日とお名前で照会できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Another section checks appointment instructions. If needed, we can inquire using your appointment date and name.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この封筒は未開封のまま預けます。自分の予約案内は予約日と名前で別に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 封筒は未開封で預け、自分の予約案内は日時と名前で別に照会したいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will hand over this envelope unopened. I want to check my own appointment instructions separately using the date and my name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hand over the unopened envelope and ask to inquire separately about your own appointment instructions by date, time and name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。二つの件を分けてご案内します。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will guide you on these two matters separately. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。受付でお困りのことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Hello. Are you having any difficulties at reception?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 問診票の薬の欄が書けません。飲んでいないのではなく、名前がわからないです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 薬の名前が不明で書けず、未服用という意味ではないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I cannot fill in the medication field on the questionnaire. It is not that I take none; I do not know the names.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you cannot write the drug names because they are unknown, not because you take no medication. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今飲んでいる薬の現物や、名前がわかる資料はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you brought the medicines themselves or information showing their names?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 家から袋を持ってきました。二種類ありますが、袋の字が読めません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二種類の薬の袋を持参したが文字が読めないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I brought the bags from home. There are two types, but I cannot read the writing on the bags.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you brought bags for two medicines but cannot read the writing. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 担当に資料を確認してもらえます。ご自身で薬の名前を推測して書く必要はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: The person in charge can check the information. You do not need to guess and write medicine names yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 名前の欄に、服用中で袋を持参したと書いてもよいですか。「なし」とは書かないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 服用中で袋持参と書いてよいか確認し、なしとは記入しないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: May I write in the name field that I am taking medication and brought the bags? I will not write 'none'.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether you may write that you are taking medication and brought the bags, and say you will not write 'none'. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、その情報を記入してください。最後に飲んだ時刻はわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, please write that information. Do you know when you last took them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二種類とも今朝七時ごろです。量は自信がないので、袋と一緒に確認してほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 両方を今朝七時に飲んだが量は不確かで、袋と一緒に確認してほしいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Both around seven this morning. I am unsure of the amounts, so I would like you to check them along with the bags.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you took both around seven this morning but the amounts are uncertain, and ask staff to check with the bags. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 時刻と、量は未確認だということも担当へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will pass on the time and that the amounts are unconfirmed to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 服用中、今朝七時、量は未確認と記入します。二つの袋を診察で見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 服用中、時刻、量は未確認と記入し、二つの袋を診察で示すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will write 'taking medication', 'seven this morning' and 'amounts unconfirmed'. I will show both bags during the consultation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will record current medication, the time and unconfirmed amounts, and show the two bags at the consultation. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。資料は手元にご用意ください。ご質問ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-02205-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please keep the materials ready. Thank you for asking.
